thread:
Nikki: Heads-up — prospect 'Seaway' wants a phased migration off CompetitorZ. They asked for: minimal SDK changes, prompt/slot parity, transparent token billing, and the ability to failback to on-prem. Can we list POC blockers?
Harpreet: Quick clarifier — do they expect exact HTTP path parity or just minimal client code changes? Sales said "drop-in where feasible".
Theo: Technical risks: 1) tokenizer mismatch causing subtle prompt/slot misalignment; 2) their client uses a custom retry/backoff header X-Retry-ID for dedupe; 3) CompetitorZ has proprietary stop-token semantics.
Victor: For tokenizer we can implement a small compatibility shim that normalizes unicode NFC, collapses whitespace, and applies a token mapping for the top 70 divergences. Not perfect but usually removes the worst-variance.
Nikki: Can Dedicated/Private honor X-Retry-ID dedupe semantics?
Theo: Yes — we can accept X-Retry-ID and dedupe at the routing layer (staging only for POC). Need to validate edgecases (id reuse, clock skew).
infra-bot: Presales environment requested: seaway-compat-shim -> staging (job 12177).
Nikki: Security/legal asks: HSM-backed keys, exportable audit logs, and a contractual no-training promise + 120d retention. Legal will push on exact retention number.
Victor: We support customer-managed KMS and HSM keywrap on Private; audit logs can be exported as newline-delimited JSON. Will attach SOC2 excerpt.
Harpreet: Pricing question — they want delta if we run quantized model variants vs CompetitorZ. Theo, can you ballpark $/1k tokens + latency tradeoffs for 8k sequence loads?
Theo: Ballpark: quantized on Dedicated ~0.45-0.7x per-token cost vs CompetitorZ depending on batch utilization. Latency p50 +10-18%, p95 depends on concurrency (+12-35%). I'll put conservative numbers into the presales cost sheet.
Nikki: Proposed POC acceptance criteria: 1) Top-1 intent/slot parity >=95% on their provided eval set; 2) p95 latency within 25% of CompetitorZ; 3) reconciled billing script + sample report showing token mapping; 4) contractual no-training + retention config in place. Target timeline 10 business days.
Harpreet: 10 days doable if they provide eval set, sample billing CSV, and allowlist IPs by COB tomorrow.
Victor: I'll upload SOC2 excerpt and KMS/HSM integration notes to the presales folder and list required egress IPs.
deploy-bot: Presales deployment queued: seaway-compat-shim v0.1 -> staging (job 12177). CI checks passing.
Nikki: Smoke test curl to share with them:
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/v1/seaway-shim/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "X-Retry-ID: abcd-1234" \ 
  -d '{"prompt":"<sample>","max_tokens":200}'
```
Harpreet: I'll draft the exact delta pricing note and include a small table for common batch sizes. Also will add a note on how batching affects p95.
Theo: I'll run baseline CompetitorZ calls for parity comparison once we have their eval set and a CompetitorZ API key. Planning a short calibration script to map stop-token behavior.
Nikki: Action items: Theo -> baseline runs + cost workbook; Harpreet -> pricing note + client comms; Victor -> security docs + IP list; Nikki -> contract addendum draft for retention/no-training.
Harpreet: One more item  customer asked about token counting differences. We should include a sample reconciliation script that maps CompetitorZ token CSV -> our billing units and flags anomalies. I'll stub it in the presales doc.
Nikki: Great. I'll chase Seaway for eval set and sample billing export. If we get those by EOD tomorrow we keep the 10-day target.
Victor: :thumbsup: uploading docs now -> https://redwood.internal/presales/seaway/docs
Nikki: Marking this thread presales-seaway-cutover for follow-up.
